usedLessons.text: Top lesson: Individual skill still wins series, but a star's lane edge only counts if it turns into a lead that carries past the early game, so I should stop assuming three lane advantages beat one elite player like Creme who can pull games into a scramble. Next time I'll weigh whether the stronger players can actually close games when a rival star neutralizes the map. I won't let BLG's depth or the crowd's hype carry a confident 2-0.
